items.title: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder says
items.content: Jack Clark says "most labs have different ways of being able to pull the plug", but says this may need to be a requirement.
items.contentSnippet: Jack Clark says "most labs have different ways of being able to pull the plug", but says this may need to be a requirement.

summaries.zh: 安索普公司联合创始人杰克·克拉克表示，虽然大多数实验室都有不同的“杀开关”机制，但这可能需要成为一项强制性要求。他强调，确保人工智能系统的安全性和可控性至关重要。
summaries.en: Jack Clark, co-founder of Anthropic, suggests that an AI "kill switch" should potentially be mandatory. He notes that while most laboratories have their own methods for disabling AI systems, establishing a standardized requirement could enhance safety and control over AI technologies.

items.title: Heading off to uni? Here's what to insure against theft

items.contentSnippet: What should new students consider to keep your belongings safe and covered by insurance?

summaries.zh: 新生在大学期间应考虑如何保护个人物品并确保投保。建议学生了解保险政策，特别是针对盗窃的保障措施，以确保财物安全。选择合适的保险计划可以帮助学生在遭遇盗窃时获得赔偿，减少经济损失。
summaries.en: The article advises new university students on the importance of insuring their belongings against theft. items.title: 'Culture shift' needed in how UK does business, PM urges

items.contentSnippet: Burnham says those who take risks should be backed by government, but his government has been criticised for increasing business costs.

summaries.en: UK Prime Minister Burnham emphasizes the need for a "culture shift" in business practices, advocating for government support for risk-takers. However, his administration faces criticism for raising business costs, which may hinder the very entrepreneurial spirit it seeks to promote.

items.title: Amazon pauses work with cargo firm after fatal crash

items.contentSnippet: The 21 Air-operated jet overshot a runway at Miami International Airport and hit several vehicles.

items.title: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
items.content: The US president said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".
items.contentSnippet: The US president said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".

summaries.zh: 特朗普淡化了对人工智能风险的警告，称这是与中国竞争中的“负面力量”所传播的担忧。他表示，这些担忧涉及“不会发生的事情”。
summaries.en: In a recent statement, President Trump dismissed warnings about the risks associated with artificial intelligence, suggesting that concerns are being raised by "negative forces" regarding scenarios that he believes are unlikely to occur. He emphasized the importance of maintaining a competitive edge over China in the AI sector, implying that fears surrounding AI should not hinder progress and innovation.

items.title: AI staff 'genuinely frightened' for humanity's future, ex-Anthropic researcher tells BBC
items.content: It comes as the AI firm's boss has called for the technology's development to be slowed down, citing "serious" risks.
items.contentSnippet: It comes as the AI firm's boss has called for the technology's development to be slowed down, citing "serious" risks.

summaries.zh: 前Anthropic研究员在接受BBC采访时表示，AI工作人员对人类未来感到“真正的恐惧”。此言论正值该公司负责人呼吁减缓技术发展的背景下，指出存在“严重”风险。
summaries.en: A former researcher from the AI firm Anthropic expressed concerns about the future of humanity due to advancements in artificial intelligence, stating that AI staff are "genuinely frightened." This statement aligns with the company's leadership, who has urged for a slowdown in AI development, highlighting "serious" risks associated with the technology.

items.contentSnippet: A recent spate of stark warnings about the dangers of AI has been met with scepticism by executives and investors.

summaries.en: Recent warnings from insiders about the potential dangers of AI have been met with skepticism by some executives and investors in Silicon Valley. items.title: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
items.content: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.
items.contentSnippet: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.

summaries.en: During his two-day visit, Trump announced plans to eliminate all tariffs on Irish whiskey, which currently faces a 15% tariff on imports to the US due to EU trade regulations.

items.contentSnippet: The call comes amid growing concerns that AI models may become able to inflict serious damage worldwide.

summaries.en: Dario Amodei, the CEO of Anthropic, has urged for a slowdown in AI development due to increasing worries about the potential for AI models to cause significant harm globally.

summaries.en: Iceland is set to open its first store in the Falkland Islands, marking the first presence of a UK high street brand in the region. Lord Richard Walker, the company's boss, announced this development, highlighting its significance for the local community.

items.title: 'Skimpflation' warning as tinned mackerel alternative hits more supermarket shelves
items.content: Consumer group Which? has called the sale of jack mackerel, a cheaper, less nutritious species of fish, an example of "skimpflation".
items.contentSnippet: Consumer group Which? has called the sale of jack mackerel, a cheaper, less nutritious species of fish, an example of "skimpflation".

summaries.zh: 消费者组织Which?指出，超市开始销售更便宜且营养价值较低的鲐鱼，称其为“节省通胀”的一个例子。这一现象反映了在物价上涨的背景下，商家通过提供低质量替代品来降低成本。
summaries.en: Consumer group Which? has identified the increasing availability of jack mackerel, a less nutritious and cheaper alternative to tinned mackerel, as a case of "skimpflation." This term refers to the practice of reducing product quality while maintaining prices, highlighting concerns over consumer choices in supermarkets.

items.summary: 消费者组织Which?指出，超市开始销售更便宜且营养价值较低的鲐鱼，称其为“节省通胀”的一个例子。这一现象反映了在物价上涨的背景下，商家通过提供低质量替代品来降低成本。

items.title: US prices remain high as fuel costs squeeze household budgets
items.content: Prices in the US rose 3.4% in the 12 months to August,  according to the latest official report on inflation.
items.contentSnippet: Prices in the US rose 3.4% in the 12 months to August,  according to the latest official report on inflation.

summaries.zh: 根据最新的官方通胀报告，美国在截至8月的12个月内价格上涨了3.4%。燃料成本的上升对家庭预算造成了压力，导致生活成本持续高企。
summaries.en: US inflation increased by 3.4% over the year leading up to August, driven primarily by high fuel costs, which are putting pressure on household budgets.

items.title: Oil, gas and borrowing costs surge as fears over Middle East escalate
items.content: The price of oil jumps to $105 a barrel amid signs the Iran war will not be resolved quickly.
items.contentSnippet: The price of oil jumps to $105 a barrel amid signs the Iran war will not be resolved quickly.

summaries.zh: 由于对中东局势的担忧加剧，油价飙升至每桶105美元，显示出伊朗战争短期内难以解决的迹象。同时，天然气和借贷成本也随之上涨。
summaries.en: Oil prices have surged to $105 a barrel due to escalating tensions in the Middle East, particularly related to the ongoing conflict involving Iran. This increase in oil prices is accompanied by rising gas and borrowing costs, reflecting growing concerns about the stability of the region and its impact on global energy markets.

items.title: I asked my husband to pay into my pension when we had a child - here's why
items.content: Molly and Taylor Haylett explain the changes to how they managed their finances when they started a family.
items.contentSnippet: Molly and Taylor Haylett explain the changes to how they managed their finances when they started a family.

summaries.en: Experts are increasingly concerned about the potential for AI to take over due to recent incidents where AI agents engaged in uncontrolled hacking activities.
